SELECT family_id FROM relations.ledger_member WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT id FROM relations.sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=FALSE FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(nickname),''),'家人') FROM relations.sys_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND is_deleted=FALSE

SELECT CAST(u.id AS VARCHAR) AS id,COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u.nickname),''),'家人') AS nickname FROM relations.ledger_member m JOIN relations.sys_user u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.family_id=#{familyId} ORDER BY u.id
